class OneBranch { x; constructor(c: boolean) { if (c) this.x = 1; } }
const oneBranch: number = new OneBranch(true).x;
class EarlyReturn { x; constructor(c: boolean) { if (c) return; this.x = 1; } }
const earlyReturn: number = new EarlyReturn(true).x;
class Unreachable { x; constructor() { return; this.x = 1; } }
class NoDefault { x; constructor(k: number) { switch (k) { case 1: this.x = 1; break; case 2: this.x = 2; } } }
const noDefault: number = new NoDefault(1).x;
class Reassigned { x; constructor() { this.x = 1; this.x = "a"; } }
class ShortCircuit { x; constructor(c: boolean) { c && (this.x = 1); } }
const shortCircuit: number = new ShortCircuit(true).x;
class Looped { x; constructor() { for (let i = 0; i < 1; i++) this.x = 1; } }
const looped: number = new Looped().x;
class InArrow { x; constructor() { const f = () => { this.x = 1; }; f(); } }
class BreakFirst { x; constructor(d: boolean) { while (true) { if (d) break; this.x = 1; } } }
const breakFirst: number = new BreakFirst(true).x;
class ReturnInLoop { x; constructor(d: boolean) { while (true) { if (d) return; this.x = 1; } } }
const returnInLoop: number = new ReturnInLoop(true).x;
class Caught { x; constructor() { try { this.x = 1; this.x = "a"; } catch { } } }
const caught: string = new Caught().x;
class DefaultReturns { x; constructor(d: number) { switch (d) { case 1: this.x = 1; break; default: return; } } }
const defaultReturns: number = new DefaultReturns(1).x;
class OnlyUndefined { x; constructor() { this.x = undefined; } }
class Nullable { x; constructor(d: boolean) { this.x = d ? "a" : null; } }
const nullable: string = new Nullable(true).x;
